_comment: Dual-mode shapes for the SRAM-accumulator path. M is always 1. N no longer has to tile the accumulator panel: the psumValid burst is fixed at freeDimensionSize cycles, but a partly-filled panel just streams zeros into its tail slots, so any N runs. The configs in 6.toroidal_dual_mode_acc.json provision a panel span of 64, so N=32 and N=64 are a SINGLE resident panel (one stationary load per K-pass — the whole N streams against each loaded A slice) while N=128 keeps the multi-panel path covered (A reloaded per panel). K sweeps one pass, a few passes, and the full provisioned maxContractionSize.
